title: feat(wire): group two die openings of one retained plate
body:
Stacked on #2979. Review the [die pair changes above the parent](https://github.com/qsmits/Camcraft/compare/17cb6f617460627b543f160f0e06821a752bac27...1e12c77a4150252c34df3f23fc2ff1c85fe2e3fa).

Process change: yes

This PR is ported onto the zero-step setup of #2984. The quality-binding correction of #2984 now applies to the die pair: the piece has one CCB030 quality object, and both works refer to it. The old writer (`jescript.rs`) is gone. The PR ports the behaviour, not the old writer.

## What changed

- **App.** Two Wire Contour operations with the die side make a die group. Each operation selects the upper rim of one through-opening of the same modeled plate. The plate must be the only model, with no placed drawing. The plate must have exactly two through-openings, one for each operation. Each selected rim must match the full-height opening of the plate (`operation/agie_die.rs`). A single die job keeps its check and its message (exactly one through-opening).
- **Post.** `export_group_with_review` accepts two die openings as well as two punches. Both works must have the same side. A punch and a die in one group are refused. Each opening gets the existing die checks of #2957 (20 mm plate, convex opening, hole inside the opening, inward lead, reach and stock margin). The clear band check now covers die openings: the cutting area of each work holds the opening, its hole and 3 mm lead, the rough corner and the wire radius. The same opening selected twice fails this check.
- **Setup.** `PunchGroup20::encode_die` writes the control-checked group records of #2961 with `ID_PUNCH,c_die` on each work. `PunchGroup20::encode` (PAIR20) keeps its bytes and its review text. The die review text tells the operator to confirm `c_die` on each work, to keep each pass inside its own opening, to check that no cutting move crosses the plate between the openings, and to support each slug.
- The example `examples/agie/die-pair.camscript` uses the current post name. The decision file is `docs/decisions/2977-wire-die-pair.md`. The user guide section "Group two die openings in one plate" has the control readings.

## Value sources

No setup value is new. Each value comes from a control-checked setup:

- The group records, the work order `CUT1`, `CUT2` and the SBR layout: PAIR20 (#2961).
- The die side `c_die` and the 20 mm rule for a die: DIE20 (#2957).
- The one CCB030 quality object: #2984.
- The 1 mm separation, steel 0001, Berco Cut 0.25 and the 20 mm offsets 245, 155, 140 and 134 µm: the existing QN2 table (#2954).
- The plate, the two rims and the threading holes X-35.5 Y0 and X24.5 Y0: the example of this PR.

## Readings

The ported DUODI20 job was imported on the emulated Classic Cut 2S control (a throwaway clone of the practice image; the base image SHA-256 did not change). No physical cut was made.

- The two ISO files and the SBL arrived on the control byte for byte.
- After import: `CUT1` and `CUT2` show `CCB030[0]`. The formal check gave one error for each work: `Technologie : te definiëren`.
- Each work: quality CCB030 (Ra 0.30, Tkm 1.0, Te 1.5, both options off), side **Matrijs**, separation 1.0, closed contour. Start holes X-35.500 Y0.000 and X24.500 Y0.000.
- TECCUT on `CUT1`: header `Dia:0.25 H:20 Ra:0.30 Tkm:1.0 Te:1.5`, row 0199, technology `estbca25nnn060b030020`. `CUT2` got the same T100. Offsets on each work: 245, 155, 140 and 134 µm. Both works then show `CCB030[4]`.
- The formal check of the piece: `Controleresultaat: geen fouten`. The warnings are the same as for PAIR20: `Uitgekozen opties : 131072` on each work and `Referentiewaarden : te definiëren`.
- GRAFICHECK (J00): ten cut blocks in this order: the main pass of `CUT1`, the main pass of `CUT2`, the separation of `CUT1`, the separation of `CUT2` (Y0 to Y1, 1.000 mm), the three trims of `CUT1`, the three trims of `CUT2`. The machine moves between the works only in transit blocks with the head up. All cutting points stay in their own opening: `CUT1` X-42.366 to X-17.634, `CUT2` X17.634 to X42.366. No cutting point is in the plate between the openings (X-17.5 to X17.5).

## Pinning tests

- `camcraft-post` `agie_die_group_setup`: `die_group_files_match_the_control_checked_die_pair` (golden `DUODI20.SBL` and `DUODI20.SBR`), `each_opening_has_its_own_geometry_die_side_quality_and_hole`, `the_die_group_differs_from_the_punch_group_only_in_the_side`, `a_single_die_keeps_its_zero_step_setup` (DIE20), `a_die_group_refuses_other_heights_counts_and_repeated_stems`.
- `camcraft-post` lib `agie::die_group_tests`: `a_die_pair_writes_an_iso_a_die_work_and_a_hole_for_each_opening`, `a_single_die_through_the_group_export_keeps_its_bytes`, `the_same_opening_twice_or_a_hole_in_the_other_opening_writes_nothing`, `the_band_between_openings_includes_the_lead_rough_corner_and_wire`, `a_die_group_refuses_another_height_or_no_separation`.
- `camcraft-app` `agie_native` `die::die_group`: `two_complete_rims_on_one_plate_post_the_control_checked_die_pair` (CLI output equals the goldens, with the ISO goldens `DUODI201.ISO` and `DUODI202.ISO`), `a_missing_shared_or_unsafe_die_work_writes_nothing` (same opening twice, one operation on a two-opening plate, hole in the other opening, a punch and a die, an extra model, slug not captured).
- The goldens that main already has (CCSEP20, DIE20 and the inspection goldens) do not change. Other goldens are listed in "Goldens moved". Existing tests pass unchanged.

## Gate

`cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` on head `1e12c77a4`: 1193 steps, 1 failed. The failed step is the known red `rotary_verify` `a_rough_over_an_oversized_bar_peels_from_the_stock_radius` (#3774). This PR does not touch that code. The pinning tests above pass. The branch merges cleanly with the current `origin/main` (`git merge-tree`).

Strict clippy (`-D warnings`, all targets) on `camcraft-post`, `camcraft-geometry`, `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-ui`: clean. No heavy lane: this is not a `P1` PR.

## Not exercised

- No physical cut. The control check was offline.
- A die group with more than two openings (#2980), a mixed punch and die group, and a die group with CCB035 are refused. The control did not check them.
- The release of each slug on a real machine. The operator must support each slug, as the review text says.

Changelog: The native wire EDM post groups two through-openings of one retained 20 mm die plate in one job.

## UI screenshots

This PR contains the two open-cutoff controls of #2972 on the Wire Contour Passes tab. One pair of images covers all five PRs of the stack. The reviewer rendered the images with the crate's egui_kittest harness.

Before (main):

![Before: Wire Contour Passes tab on main](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/pr-screenshots/pr-2972/wire-open-cutoff-before.png?raw=true)

After (with the two cutoff controls):

![After: Wire Contour Passes tab with the two cutoff controls](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/pr-screenshots/pr-2972/wire-open-cutoff-after.png?raw=true)

## Goldens moved

The golden files below are additions relative to main. This PR changes no golden file that main already has. The goldens CCSEP20 and DIE20 of main do not change.

- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/CIRCLE20.ISO` (A): pins the ISO of a placed circle DXF job. Added by #2978 of the stack.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/DUODI201.ISO` (A): pins the ISO of die opening 1 of the die pair. Added by #2981 of the stack.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/DUODI202.ISO` (A): pins the ISO of die opening 2 of the die pair. Added by #2981 of the stack.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/FINE20.ISO` (A): pins the ISO of the FINE20 job with quality CCB035. Added by #2979 of the stack.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/FINE20.SBL` (A): pins the SBL of the FINE20 job with quality CCB035. Added by #2979 of the stack.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/FINE20.SBR` (A): pins the SBR of the FINE20 job with quality CCB035. Added by #2979 of the stack.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/RACE20.ISO` (A): pins the ISO of a placed racetrack DXF job. Added by #2978 of the stack.
- `crates/post/tests/golden/agie-setup/DUODI20.SBL` (A): pins the SBL of a die pair on one retained plate. Added by #2981 of the stack.
- `crates/post/tests/golden/agie-setup/DUODI20.SBR` (A): pins the SBR of a die pair on one retained plate. Added by #2981 of the stack.
- `crates/post/tests/golden/agie-setup/LOWER20.SBL` (A): pins the open-cutoff (zero-step, one cut) setup SBL. Added by #2972 of the stack.
- `crates/post/tests/golden/agie-setup/PAIR20.SBL` (A): pins the SBL of a group of two punches on one plate. Added by #2974 of the stack.
- `crates/post/tests/golden/agie-setup/PAIR20.SBR` (A): pins the SBR of a group of two punches on one plate. Added by #2974 of the stack.

## Test layout

The new top-level test binaries move into the existing `agie_safe_setup` and `agie_native` suites in the next push; this body is updated then.
